subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the meeting-browser permission callback be accepted as an immediate required Plugin SDK contract change, or should the SDK provide an additive compatibility/deprecation path for existing external adapters?
rationale: The implementation affects a documented Plugin SDK seam used beyond the bundled Teams and Google Meet plugins; repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for shipped external API evolution.

options.title: Add a compatibility migration path
options.body: Keep URL-aware core permission grants while preserving or explicitly versioning the prior adapter contract with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Accept the immediate contract change
options.body: Approve the required new callback input as a deliberate SDK break and document the exact external-plugin upgrade requirement.

recommendation.title: Add a compatibility migration path
recommendation.body: Keep URL-aware core permission grants while preserving or explicitly versioning the prior adapter contract with focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the merged Teams adapter and authored the current shared meeting-runtime API change.
